quote: Pārvatī ("daughter of the mountain," also known as Umā) is considered one of the most beloved goddesses in the Hindu pantheon, although she has not been the focus of sustained scholarly study.

statement.id: Parvati adalah dewi Hindu yang namanya bermakna putri gunung dan juga disebut Uma.
statement.en: Parvati is a Hindu goddess whose name means daughter of the mountain and who is also called Uma.

quote: She figures prominently as the devoted wife of the great god Śiva, mother of Gaṇeśa and Skanda (also known as Kārttikeya or Murugan), and is closely aligned with the benign aspect of Mahādevī, the Great Goddess.

statement.id: Parvati adalah istri Siwa serta ibu Ganesha dan Skanda, dan berhubungan dengan aspek lembut Mahadevi.
statement.en: Parvati is Shiva's wife and the mother of Ganesha and Skanda, associated with Mahadevi's benign aspect.

quote: Her mythic profile unfolds through enduring stories told in the purāṇas including her rebirth as the daughter of Himavat and Menā, her practice of tapas (asceticism), her wedding ceremony and marriage to Śiva, the birth of her sons, her emanation as Durgā, the game of dice, and her role as half of Śiva’s body in the androgynous form Ardhanārīśvara (the half-woman lord).

statement.id: Kisah Purana menyebut Parvati terlahir kembali sebagai putri Himavat dan Mena serta melakukan tapa dan menikahi Siwa.
statement.en: Purana stories recount Parvati's rebirth as daughter of Himavat and Mena, her ascetic practice, and marriage to Shiva.

quote: However, Pārvatī is not only Śiva’s wife; she is also his śakti, mother of the universe and a disciplined female ascetic (tapasvinī) in her own right.

statement.id: Parvati juga digambarkan sebagai sakti Siwa, ibu semesta, dan petapa perempuan.
statement.en: Parvati is also Shiva's shakti, mother of the universe, and an ascetic in her own right.

quote: Hindu Goddess of the Mountain, also known as Uma; she is often seen as the feminine half of the god Shiva, and the divine feminine power of the universe (shakti).

statement.id: Smithsonian menggambarkan Parvati atau Uma sebagai dewi gunung dan kekuatan feminin ilahi.
statement.en: The Smithsonian describes Parvati or Uma as a mountain goddess and divine feminine power.

quote: The Puranas, literally the “old stories” of Hindu traditions, relate the narrative of the goddess Parvati, who aspired to marry the god Shiva.

statement.id: Purana menceritakan Parvati ingin menikah dengan Siwa.
statement.en: The Puranas tell of Parvati's wish to marry Shiva.

quote: Because Shiva could not easily be distracted from his yogic meditation, Parvati subjected herself to extreme acts of physical deprivation—such as meditating in cold water during the winter—to gain supernatural powers and win over the celibate god.

statement.id: Parvati menjalani tapa berat untuk memperoleh kekuatan dan memikat Siwa yang sedang bertapa.
statement.en: Parvati performed severe asceticism to gain power and win over the meditating Shiva.

quote: The Hindu goddess Parvati, the daughter of the Himalayan Mountains, is worshiped both as Shiva's wife and as an independent deity.

statement.id: Parvati dipuja sebagai istri Siwa dan sebagai dewi tersendiri.
statement.en: Parvati is worshiped as Shiva's wife and as an independent goddess.

quote: She stands in a traditional posture of self-assured grace, the triple-bend pose (tribhanga) in which the head and lower body slant in one direction, while the torso moves in the opposite direction.

statement.id: Arca Parvati di Asia Society berdiri dalam pose tribhanga dengan tiga tekukan.
statement.en: The Asia Society's Parvati statue stands in the triple-bend tribhanga pose.

quote: In South India, where this sculpture was made, the Hindu goddess Parvati is known as Uma.

statement.id: Di India Selatan, Parvati juga dikenal sebagai Uma.
statement.en: In South India, Parvati is also known as Uma.

quote: Born once again, for in an earlier life High fame was hers, as Śiva's faithful wife.

statement.id: Dalam puisi Kalidasa itu, Parvati dilukiskan lahir kembali; dalam kehidupan sebelumnya ia terkenal sebagai istri setia Siwa.
statement.en: In Kalidasa's poem, Parvati is described as born again, having been famed in an earlier life as Shiva's faithful wife.

quote: But her proud sire had dared the God to scorn; Then was her tender soul with anguish torn, And jealous for the lord she loved so well, Her angered spirit left its mortal cell.

statement.id: Dalam kehidupan sebelumnya, ayahnya yang congkak berani menghina sang dewa; sang istri yang membela suaminya pun meninggalkan tubuhnya.
statement.en: In her earlier life her proud father dared to scorn the god, and she, defending the lord she loved, left her mortal body.

quote: Child of the Mountain was her only name. ... when her mother, filled with anxious care At her stern penance, cried Forbear! Forbear! To a new title was the warning turned

statement.id: Semula satu-satunya namanya adalah "Anak Gunung"; ketika ibunya, cemas melihat tapanya yang keras, berseru "Forbear!" (jangan!), seruan itu menjadi gelar barunya.
statement.en: At first her only name was "Child of the Mountain"; when her anxious mother cried "Forbear!" at her stern penance, the warning became a new title.

quote: Alas! that angry eye's resistless flashes Have scorched the gentle King of Love to ashes!

statement.id: Dalam puisi itu, kilatan mata murka Siwa membakar sang Raja Cinta menjadi abu.
statement.en: In the poem, the flashes of Shiva's angry eye scorch the King of Love to ashes.

quote: Penance must aid her now—or how can she Win the cold heart of that stern deity?

statement.id: Dalam puisi itu, hanya tapa yang dapat membantu Parvati memenangkan hati dewa yang dingin dan keras itu.
statement.en: In the poem, only penance can help her win the cold heart of the stern deity.

quote: She would not spare her form, so fair and frail, If sterner penance could perchance prevail.

statement.id: Parvati tidak mau menyayangi tubuhnya yang indah dan lemah jika tapa yang lebih keras mungkin berhasil.
statement.en: Parvati would not spare her fair, frail body if sterner penance might prevail.

quote: Won by thy penance, and thy holy vows, Thy willing slave Śiva before thee bows.

statement.id: Siwa berkata kepadanya bahwa, karena tapa dan sumpah sucinya, ia rela menjadi hamba yang tunduk di hadapannya.
statement.en: Shiva tells her that, won by her penance and holy vows, he bows before her as her willing slave.

quote: Sati is then reborn as Parvati, the daughter of Himavat and Mainavati, and is named Parvati, or "she from the mountains", after her father Himavant who is also called king Parvat.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Sati terlahir kembali sebagai Parvati, putri Himavat dan Mainavati, dan dinamai Parvati, "dia dari pegunungan", menurut nama ayahnya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Sati is reborn as Parvati, daughter of Himavat and Mainavati, and named Parvati, "she from the mountains", after her father.

quote: Indra sends the god Kama – the Hindu god of desire, erotic love, attraction, and affection, to awake Shiva from meditation.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, Indra mengutus Kama, dewa hasrat dan cinta, untuk membangunkan Siwa dari meditasinya.
statement.en: In the story Indra sends Kama, the god of desire and love, to awaken Shiva from meditation.

quote: After the marriage, Parvati moves to Mount Kailash, the residence of Shiva. To them are born Kartikeya (also known as Skanda and Murugan) – the leader of celestial armies, and Ganesha – the god of wisdom that prevents problems and removes obstacles.

statement.id: Setelah menikah, Parvati pindah ke Gunung Kailash, kediaman Siwa; dari mereka lahir Kartikeya (Skanda, Murugan), pemimpin pasukan langit, dan Ganesha, dewa kebijaksanaan penghalau rintangan.
statement.en: After the marriage Parvati moves to Mount Kailash, Shiva's residence; to them are born Kartikeya (Skanda, Murugan), leader of celestial armies, and Ganesha, god of wisdom who removes obstacles.

quote: she created an image of a boy out of turmeric paste which she prepared to cleanse her body and infused life into it, and thus Ganesha was born.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, Parvati membentuk patung anak laki-laki dari pasta kunyit untuk membersihkan tubuh, lalu menghidupkannya; maka lahirlah Ganesha.
statement.en: In one story Parvati shaped a boy from turmeric paste used to cleanse her body and gave it life, and thus Ganesha was born.

quote: Shiva was infuriated, lost his temper, and severed the boy's head with his trident.

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, Siwa murka dan memenggal kepala anak itu dengan trisulanya setelah dihalangi masuk.
statement.en: In that story Shiva, infuriated, severed the boy's head with his trident.

quote: Shiva did so by attaching an elephant's head to Ganesha's body, thus giving rise to the elephant-headed deity.

statement.id: Atas tuntutan Parvati, Siwa menghidupkan kembali anak itu dengan memasang kepala gajah, sehingga lahir dewa berkepala gajah.
statement.en: At Parvati's demand Shiva restored the boy by attaching an elephant's head, giving rise to the elephant-headed deity.

quote: Parvati, the gentle aspect of Devi Shakti, is usually represented as fair, beautiful, and benevolent.

statement.id: Parvati, aspek lembut Dewi Shakti, biasanya digambarkan berkulit cerah, cantik, dan baik hati.
statement.en: Parvati, the gentle aspect of Devi Shakti, is usually represented as fair, beautiful, and benevolent.

quote: These hands may hold a trident, mirror, rosary, bell, dish, goad, sugarcane stalk, or flowers (such as a lotus).

statement.id: Tangan Parvati dapat memegang trisula, cermin, tasbih, lonceng, piring, tongkat penggiring gajah, batang tebu, atau bunga seperti teratai.
statement.en: Parvati's hands may hold a trident, mirror, rosary, bell, dish, goad, sugarcane stalk, or flowers such as a lotus.

quote: In Skanda Purana, Parvati assumes the form of a warrior-goddess and defeats a demon called Durg who assumes the form of a buffalo. In this aspect, she is known by the name Durga.

statement.id: Dalam Skanda Purana, Parvati mengambil wujud dewi prajurit dan mengalahkan iblis bernama Durg yang berwujud kerbau; dalam aspek ini ia dikenal sebagai Durga.
statement.en: In the Skanda Purana Parvati takes the form of a warrior-goddess and defeats a demon named Durg who takes the form of a buffalo; in this aspect she is known as Durga.

quote: In Linga Purana, Parvati undergoes a metamorphosis into Kali, at the request of Shiva, to destroy an asura (demon) Daruk.

statement.id: Dalam Linga Purana, atas permintaan Siwa, Parvati berubah menjadi Kali untuk membinasakan asura (iblis) Daruk.
statement.en: In the Linga Purana, at Shiva's request, Parvati transforms into Kali to destroy the asura (demon) Daruk.

quote: As Mahakali, she identifies and destroys evil for protection, and as Annapurna, she creates food and abundance for nourishment.

statement.id: Sebagai Mahakali ia mengenali dan menumpas kejahatan demi perlindungan, dan sebagai Annapurna ia menciptakan pangan dan kelimpahan.
statement.en: As Mahakali she identifies and destroys evil for protection, and as Annapurna she creates food and abundance for nourishment.

quote: Her rage at Shiva's attempt to walk out manifests in the form of ten terrifying goddesses who block Shiva's every exit.

statement.id: Dalam kisah kelahiran sepuluh Mahavidya, kemarahan Parvati ketika Siwa hendak pergi menjelma sepuluh dewi menyeramkan yang menghalangi setiap jalan keluarnya.
statement.en: In the story of the ten Mahavidyas, Parvati's rage at Shiva's attempt to leave takes the form of ten terrifying goddesses who block his every exit.

quote: Shaiva's approaches tend to look upon Parvati as the Shiva's submissive and obedient wife. However, Shaktas focus on Parvati's equality or even superiority to her consort.

statement.id: Pendekatan Saiwa cenderung memandang Parvati sebagai istri Siwa yang patuh, sedangkan kaum Sakta menekankan kesetaraan atau bahkan keunggulannya atas pasangannya.
statement.en: Shaiva approaches tend to view Parvati as Shiva's submissive, obedient wife, whereas Shaktas stress her equality or even superiority to her consort.

quote: Three images are central to the ethos, iconography, and philosophy of Parvati: the image of Shiva-Shakti, the image of Shiva as Ardhanarishvara (the Lord who is half-woman), and the image of the linga and the yoni.

statement.id: Tiga citra menjadi pusat etos, ikonografi, dan filsafat Parvati: Siwa-Sakti, Siwa sebagai Ardhanarishvara (Tuhan setengah perempuan), serta linga dan yoni.
statement.en: Three images are central to Parvati's ethos, iconography, and philosophy: Shiva-Shakti, Shiva as Ardhanarishvara (the Lord who is half-woman), and the linga and the yoni.

quote: Teej is a significant festival for Hindu women, particularly in the northern and western states of India. Parvati is the primary deity of the festival

statement.id: Teej adalah festival penting bagi perempuan Hindu, terutama di negara bagian utara dan barat India; Parvati adalah dewa utama festival itu.
statement.en: Teej is a significant festival for Hindu women, particularly in the northern and western states of India, and Parvati is its primary deity.

quote: Parvati, locally spelled as Parwati, is a principal goddess in modern-day Hinduism of Bali. She is more often called Uma, and sometimes referred to as Giriputri (daughter of the mountains).

statement.id: Di Bali, Parvati dieja Parwati dan merupakan dewi utama dalam Hindu Bali; ia lebih sering disebut Uma dan kadang Giriputri (putri gunung).
statement.en: In Bali, Parvati is spelled Parwati and is a principal goddess of Balinese Hinduism; she is more often called Uma and sometimes Giriputri (daughter of the mountains).

quote: As Dewi Danu, she presides over waters, lake Batur and Gunung Batur, a major volcano in Bali.

statement.id: Sebagai Dewi Danu, ia menguasai perairan, Danau Batur, dan Gunung Batur, gunung berapi besar di Bali.
statement.en: As Dewi Danu she presides over waters, Lake Batur, and Gunung Batur, a major volcano in Bali.

quote: Sati-Parvati appears in the epic period (400 BCE–400 CE), as both the Ramayana and the Mahabharata present Parvati as Shiva's wife.

statement.id: Sati-Parvati muncul pada masa epos (400 SM-400 M), ketika Ramayana dan Mahabharata menampilkan Parvati sebagai istri Siwa.
statement.en: Sati-Parvati appears in the epic period (400 BCE-400 CE), when both the Ramayana and the Mahabharata present Parvati as Shiva's wife.

quote: Parvata (पर्वत ) is one of the Sanskrit words for "mountain"; "Parvati" derives her name from being incarnated as the daughter of king Himavan (also called Himavata, Parvata)

statement.id: Parvata adalah salah satu kata Sanskerta untuk "gunung"; nama Parvati berasal dari kelahirannya sebagai putri Raja Himavan (juga disebut Himavata, Parvata).
statement.en: Parvata is one of the Sanskrit words for "mountain"; the name Parvati derives from her incarnation as daughter of king Himavan (also called Himavata, Parvata).

quote: Parvati (Sanskrit: पार्वती , IAST: Pārvatī), also known as Uma (Sanskrit: उमा , IAST: Umā) and Gauri (Sanskrit: गौरी , IAST: Gaurī), is one of the principal goddesses in Hinduism

statement.id: Parvati (Sanskerta: पार्वती), juga dikenal sebagai Uma dan Gauri, adalah salah satu dewi utama dalam agama Hindu.
statement.en: Parvati (Sanskrit: पार्वती), also known as Uma and Gauri, is one of the principal goddesses in Hinduism.

quote: Meenakshi, regional form of Parvati in Madurai. She is considered the queen of Madurai.

statement.id: Meenakshi adalah wujud regional Parvati di Madurai dan dianggap ratu Madurai.
statement.en: Meenakshi is a regional form of Parvati in Madurai and is considered the queen of Madurai.

quote: Kalidasa's epic Kumarasambhavam ("Birth of Kumara") describes the story of the maiden Parvati who has made up her mind to marry Shiva and get him out of his recluse, intellectual, austere world of aloofness.

statement.id: Epos Kumarasambhavam karya Kalidasa menceritakan Parvati yang bertekad menikahi Siwa dan membawanya keluar dari dunia pertapaannya yang menyendiri.
statement.en: Kalidasa's epic Kumarasambhavam ("Birth of Kumara") tells of the maiden Parvati, determined to marry Shiva and draw him out of his austere, aloof world.

quote: However, it is not until the plays of Kalidasa (5th–6th centuries) and the Puranas (4th through the 13th centuries) that the stories of Sati-Parvati and Shiva acquire more comprehensive details.

statement.id: Baru pada drama Kalidasa (abad ke-5 sampai ke-6) dan Purana (abad ke-4 sampai ke-13) kisah Sati-Parvati dan Siwa memperoleh detail yang lebih lengkap.
statement.en: Only with Kalidasa's plays (5th-6th centuries) and the Puranas (4th through 13th centuries) do the stories of Sati-Parvati and Shiva gain fuller detail.
